heard: In December 1935, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry soared above the Libyan desert. At midnight, his plane clipped a plateau in the dark. He and André Prévat had only a pint of coffee. They wandered for four days through heat and hallucinations. A Bedouin traveler saved them with a gift of water. This miracle inspired the setting of the little prince. The pilot had survived the sands where he first soared.
